thread:
ana: heads up — found partner webhook logs in gs://partners-logs/2026-03-19/... that include a plaintext DB_URL and a couple of vault-wrapped blobs. looks like staging creds leaked. tagging sec and infra.
mike: can you paste an example (sanitized)? need to know if it's raw creds or wrapped.
ana: sanitized snippet: "DB_URL=postgres://staging_user:REDACTED@staging-db.internal:5432/dbname?sslmode=require" and also a vault pointer: "vault://secret/data/staging/db#enc=base64:AAAA..." — file is gs://partners-logs/2026-03-19/evt-8742.json
lena: ok containment checklist (quick): 1) disable staging DB user 2) rotate creds in Vault 3) rewrap any Vault-transit-wrapped blobs / rotate KMS keys if needed 4) remove partner read RBAC on the bucket. who will take what?
jordy: sec oncall — created INC-2026-0427. Assigning: mike -> rotate DB creds & deployments, lena -> Vault/KMS rewrap & config, ana -> partner takedown + coordination, i'll do audit log review. Also need to check if any service accounts performed KMS decrypts recently.
mike: i'm on rotate. I'll run in staging workspace: `vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/db` first to confirm, then revoke staging_user: `psql -c "ALTER ROLE staging_user NOLOGIN;"` and create staging_user_v2. will push new creds to Vault and update k8s secret refs. planning canary deploy then cutover. ETA ~30m.
lena: for rewrap plan: prefer Vault transit rewrap so we don't decrypt partner blobs ourselves. Steps: create new KMS key version, update Vault auto-unseal / transit key binding, use Vault rewrap API to rewrap ciphertext. i'll open PR to change the kms key binding in infra and schedule rewrap job. do not decrypt partner blobs locally.
jordy: short policy: if partner stored raw creds -> assume compromise, rotate DB & secrets; if vault-wrapped -> rotate transit keys + rewrap via Vault. also check `vault audit list` and Cloud KMS audit logs: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND protoPayload.methodName:DecryptKeyVersion"` for suspicious decrypts.
ana: confirmed logs contain at least one raw DB_URL plus two vault-wrapped entries. assume full exposure — proceeding with full rotation + partner takedown.
mike: rotated creds, created staging_user_v2, pushed new secret to `secret/data/staging/db` and updated k8s secret ref to staging-user-v2. canary deployed (1 pod). monitoring 0 -> 5xx spikes. will keep watch and roll if any issues.
lena: finished transit key rotation & rewrap run. used Vault rewrap batch job against secret/data/staging/*, no plaintext exposure. updated Vault -> KMS binding to use new key version. also removed `roles/storage.objectViewer` for partner-sa on gs://partners-logs. PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/492
sec-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0427 created by jordy. Severity: medium. Tasks assigned: rotate DB creds (mike), vault transit rotate (lena), partner takedown (ana), audit log review (jordy). Postmortem due in 72 hours.
ops-bot: reminder: update Redwood Console secret refs and ensure Dedicated/Private deployments reference new secret path. use canary & monitor DB connections and error rates for 1 hour after cutover.
ana: i've emailed partner ops/legal asking for immediate log scrub + retention prune and confirmation of who accessed the bucket. opening follow-up ticket #4238 for partner communications.
mike: monitoring green for 20m after cutover, no errors. removed old staging_user credentials from Vault. leaving old keys disabled for 24h then will destroy.
jordy: audit review notes: no external KMS decrypts outside partner-SA range, but found 3 unauth'ed reads of the specific object by partner svcacct — partner claims webhook was misconfigured. we tightened RBAC and added log-based alert for any read of partner bucket objects containing "DB_URL" pattern.
lena: added audit sink forwarding to sec-sink and increased retention for vault-audit logs to 90 days. also added automation to rotate transit key every 30 days for staging environments.
jordy: containment complete. next steps: schedule RBAC sweep for partner buckets + KMS keys, run tabletop on partner log leak scenarios, and draft postmortem. closing thread but keeping INC open until postmortem published.
